storyTemplate.title: Sandbox Crime Story
storyTemplate.description: A crime start: enter the back room of a city bar and decide how to handle the first illegal offer.

messages.speaker: Narrator
messages.text:
The Blue Lantern's front room is all cheap music and wet coats. The back room is quieter.

A table waits under a single green lamp. An envelope sits in the center beside two untouched glasses of whiskey, and the alley door behind you has already clicked shut.

Whoever arranged this meeting wants you to read the offer first.
